zh.title: 中秋及教師節離島航線第二波加班機 8月26日開放訂位
zh.summary: 民航局宣布中秋及教師節連假離島航線第二波加班機，8月26日起開放訂位。
body: 交通部民用航空局於8月21日宣布，因應民眾中秋節及教師節連假返鄉與旅遊需求，已針對需求較高的澎湖及金門航線規劃第二波加班機與放大機型，並定於8月26日上午9時起統一開放訂位。
民航局表示，第二波加班機及放大機型規劃中，澎湖航線將提供4,920個座位，金門航線提供2,464個座位，總計增加7,384個座位數。民航局提醒旅客，取得訂位後應依各航空公司規定的期限完成開票。
民航局指出，今年中秋及教師節離島管制航線已於7月27日開放正班機及第一波加班機訂位。尖峰時段包括9月24日至9月26日由臺灣出發往離島，以及9月27日至9月29日由離島返回臺灣之機票，均會加註「限當日當班次」與「逾期作廢」等使用限制。

en.title: Taiwan CAA to Open Mid-Autumn Holiday Second-Wave Extra Flight Bookings on Aug 26
en.summary: Taiwan CAA opens bookings for second-wave holiday extra flights to Penghu and Kinmen on August 26.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration announced on August 21 that booking for a second wave of additional flights and upgraded aircraft capacity on Penghu and Kinmen routes will open on August 26 at 9 a.m. to meet travel demand during the Mid-Autumn and Teachers' Day holidays.

According to the agency, the second wave of extra services will add 4,920 seats for Penghu routes and 2,464 seats for Kinmen routes, providing a total of 7,384 seats. Passengers are advised to complete ticket issuance within airline deadlines to secure their bookings.

The agency added that regular flights and initial extra capacity for offshore island routes opened on July 27. Tickets for peak travel dates—September 24 to September 26 for outbound travel from Taiwan and September 27 to September 29 for return travel—carry restrictions, including single-flight validity and invalidation after expiration.
